title_sq: SHESIM APARTAMENT 2+1+2 +2 POSTE PARKIMI, REZIDENCA "LONG HILL"!
description_sq:
Long Hill Residence eshte krijuar si nje filozofi jetese ku cdo element eshte pershtatur per te krijuar jetese qe harmonizohet me natyrën dhe permireson cilesine e jetes. Koncepti i pyllit garanton qetesine dhe sigurine per banoret, duke krijuar nje ambient ekskluziv ku mund te banohet larg kaosit urban, ku rruget u takojne njerezve, jo makinave, ku femijet mund te luajne te shpenguar ne ajer te paster.
Rezidenca nder te tjera te ofron bar, restorant dhe pishine verore.
Te dhenat e apartamentit:
Siperfaqe neto 126 m2
Siperfaqe totale 139 m2
Perbehet nga:
-Ambient ndenje me pamje panoramike me vetrate xhami dhe me akses ne ballkon.
-Dhome gjumi matrimoniale me garderobe, tualet personal dhe po ashtu me akses ne ballkon.
-Dhome femijesh me 2 shtreter.
- 2 ballkone
- 2 tualete
- Orientimi: Lindje - Perendim me pamje te lire.
- Investim modern i bere me arkitekt.
Apartamenti disponon dhe 2 poste parkimi te perfshira ne cmim.
Per me shume infoo na kontaktoni !
title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+2 +2 PARKING SPACE, "LONG HILL" RESIDENCE!
description_en: Long Hill Residence was created as a philosophy of life where every element is adapted to create a lifestyle that harmonizes with nature and improves the quality of life. The concept of the forest guarantees peace and security for residents, creating an exclusive environment where you can live away from urban chaos, where the roads belong to people, not cars, where children can play in the fresh air. The residence offers, among other things, a bar, a restaurant and a summer pool. Apartment details: Net area 126 m2 Total area 139 m2 It consists of: -Living room with panoramic view with glass windows and access to the balcony. - Matrimonial bedroom with wardrobe, personal toilet and also with access to the balcony. -Children's room with 2 beds. - 2 balconies - 2 toilets - Orientation: East - West with a free view. - Modern investment made with an architect. The apartment also has 2 parking spaces included in the price. For more information, contact us!
